name: SYMLIFE
recent: SYMLIFE 完成了第三批也是最后一批私募配售，以每股 RM0.1460 发行 20,600,700 股新股，并于 2026 年 10 月 23 日上市。公司近期也出现 XOX BHD 及 XOX (HONG KONG) LIMITED 的大股东权益变动申报，以及数项重大诉讼公告。
notable: 完成第三批私募配售，发行 20,600,700 股新股，发行价每股 RM0.1460，并于 2026 年 10 月 23 日上市。
XOX BHD 及 XOX (HONG KONG) LIMITED 出现大股东权益变动申报。
risks: 私募配售新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
公司有数项重大诉讼公告。

events.what: 第三批私募配售股份上市
events.what_en: Listing of third tranche placement shares

recent_en: SYMLIFE completed the third and final tranche of its private placement, issuing 20,600,700 new shares at RM0.1460 each, which were listed on 23 October 2026. The company also saw substantial shareholder interest change filings by XOX BHD and XOX (HONG KONG) LIMITED, along with several material litigation announcements.
notable_en: Completed the third tranche of private placement, issuing 20,600,700 new shares at RM0.1460 each, listed on 23 October 2026.
Substantial shareholder interest change filings by XOX BHD and XOX (HONG KONG) LIMITED.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares may dilute existing shareholders' holdings.
The company has several material litigation announcements.
